title: 水位上升的泳池中游泳
summary: n×n 网格每格有高度，水位随时间升高；求从左上到右下可达所需的最早时间。
insight: 路径代价是沿途高度最大值；使用 Dijkstra，每次扩展当前路径最大高度最小的格子，首次到终点即为最优。
pitfalls: 移动到相邻格后的代价是 max(当前代价,新格高度)

solutions.title: 最小化最大高度的 Dijkstra
solutions.idea: 以路径最大高度作为距离进行松弛。
steps: 弹出格子，对四邻居计算 next=max(time,height)
若 next 更小则更新并入堆；弹出终点时返回 time

code.java: class Solution { public int swimInWater(int[][] grid){int n=grid.length;int[][] distance=new int[n][n];for(int[] row:distance)Arrays.fill(row,Integer.MAX_VALUE);distance[0][0]=grid[0][0];PriorityQueue<int[]> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));heap.offer(new int[]{grid[0][0],0,0});int[] directions={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!heap.isEmpty()){int[] state=heap.poll();int time=state[0],row=state[1],column=state[2];if(time!=distance[row][column])continue;if(row==n-1&&column==n-1)return time;for(int d=0;d<4;d++){int nextRow=row+directions[d],nextColumn=column+directions[d+1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=n||nextColumn<0||nextColumn>=n)continue;int next=Math.max(time,grid[nextRow][nextColumn]);if(next<distance[nextRow][nextColumn]){distance[nextRow][nextColumn]=next;heap.offer(new int[]{next,nextRow,nextColumn});}}}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun swimInWater(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=grid.size;val distance=Array(n){IntArray(n){Int.MAX_VALUE}};distance[0][0]=grid[0][0];val heap=java.util.PriorityQueue<IntArray>(compareBy{it[0]});heap.add(intArrayOf(grid[0][0],0,0));val directions=intArrayOf(-1,0,1,0,-1);while(heap.isNotEmpty()){val state=heap.remove();val time=state[0];val row=state[1];val column=state[2];if(time!=distance[row][column])continue;if(row==n-1&&column==n-1)return time;for(d in 0 until 4){val nextRow=row+directions[d];val nextColumn=column+directions[d+1];if(nextRow !in 0 until n||nextColumn !in 0 until n)continue;val next=maxOf(time,grid[nextRow][nextColumn]);if(next<distance[nextRow][nextColumn]){distance[nextRow][nextColumn]=next;heap.add(intArrayOf(next,nextRow,nextColumn))}}};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int swimInWater(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int n=grid.size();vector<vector<int>> distance(n,vector<int>(n,INT_MAX));priority_queue<array<int,3>,vector<array<int,3>>,greater<array<int,3>>> heap;distance[0][0]=grid[0][0];heap.push({grid[0][0],0,0});int directions[5]={-1,0,1,0,-1};while(!heap.empty()){auto [time,row,column]=heap.top();heap.pop();if(time!=distance[row][column])continue;if(row==n-1&&column==n-1)return time;for(int d=0;d<4;++d){int nextRow=row+directions[d],nextColumn=column+directions[d+1];if(nextRow<0||nextRow>=n||nextColumn<0||nextColumn>=n)continue;int next=max(time,grid[nextRow][nextColumn]);if(next<distance[nextRow][nextColumn]){distance[nextRow][nextColumn]=next;heap.push({next,nextRow,nextColumn});}}}return -1;} };
